digest.component_or_area: optional dependency plumbing and runtime guard
propositions: Declare s3 optional extra in pyproject.toml with git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 dependency
Implement require_s3_helper() in _optional.py that validates both PATH presence of git-remote-s3 console script and distribution version meets 0.3.2 minimum
require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with actionable install hint when script is missing, metadata is absent, version is too old, or unparseable
Version parsing must be stdlib-only using tuple comparison of leading numeric components; suffixed versions like 0.3.2.post1 pass; completely non-numeric versions fail closed
guard_import('git_remote_s3', extra='s3') must produce standard error message containing pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' when module absent
